parallel.description: Number of repositories processed at the same time.

theme.description: Path of a YAML file that changes the colors of the output.

errexit.description: Stop starting new jobs after the first error.

provider-cache-ttl.description: How long a workspace discovered from a GitHub or GitLab organization is kept, for example 30m, 12h or 1h30m.

update-check.description: Look once a day whether a newer release exists, and print a notice.

global-fallback.description: Use the global workspace when no workspace is found from the current folder.

trusted-workspaces.description: Deprecated. It no longer trusts anything: hooks are trusted file by file.
